headword: {必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく}

definitions.explanation: An academic course that students must take to fulfill graduation requirements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく}だ。
{必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: If you fail a required course, you can't graduate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦{科目|かもく}→科目：00163_kamoku⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are ten required courses in the first year.

notes:
{必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく} refers to courses that are mandatory for all students in a program. Failing to complete required courses prevents graduation.
